metadata.name: WDG Mycenaean Tunic, fitted and extended as the ghost nightdress
metadata.author: WDG; clavicle skin from MakeHuman Team / Data Collection AB / Joel Palmius / Jonas Hauquier
metadata.licenseBasis: Official current dress01 pack catalog explicitly lists wdg_mycenaean_tunic as CC0. The original legacy MHCLO header says AGPL3; retained in external source provenance, not rewritten. Body source explicitly released CC0 in September2020.
metadata.construction: Supplied hm08 single/barycentric fit to pinned adult Asian female. Body scale x .13,y .14 above pelvis/.21 below,z .11. Extend upper-arm length32% and12mm cloth ease with harmonic cuff-to-bodice weights; lower skirt gains18% side/65% depth allowance. Original connected garment topology and authored UV seams retained. Clavicle skin excerpt from the same body group: source y3.2..4.55 clipped in XZ to the collar convex aperture plus5mm overlap; boundaries stay beneath opaque clothing.
